Title: The favorite promise of French presidential candidates: Referendums
Subhead: Following the lead of Marine Le Pen, who has long promised to organize referendums, several candidates seem to see direct democracy as a fix for the presidential legitimacy crisis and the political system's deadlock.

Title: Ukrainians are numbed by the constant repetition of air raid alerts
Subhead: As Russian strikes increase and become more deadly, Ukraine's major cities are racing to modernize their alert systems. Yet, a growing number of overwhelmed civilians no longer respond to the warnings.

Title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
Subhead: For many people in France, the goal is to hear only the sounds of nature and to avoid being caught up in a tide of tourists. The good news is that in most areas where peace and quiet can still be found, real estate prices remain low.

Title: Venezuelan photographer Silvana Trevale's captivating photos of joy amidst the 'whirlwind of collapse'
Subhead: 'Youth in hostile environments' (5/7). After fleeing crisis-stricken Venezuela, Silvana Trevale has regularly returned to photograph the country's youth – capturing the carefree moments of boys and girls who, despite a lack of prospects, embody the vital spirit of Venezuelan society.

Title: Spanish Civil War: 'How I found my Republican great-grandfather, forgotten in mass graves'
Subhead: Like thousands of other Spanish Republicans, José Molina Lopez was cast into an anonymous mass grave and had his memory erased by the narrative imposed by the dictator Franco. Journalist Garance Muñoz retraced her great-grandfather's story, a reparative journey enabled by laws passed since 2007.

Title: West Bank children through the lens of Palestinian photographer Sakir Khader
Subhead: 'Growing up in hostile environments' (4/7). Based in the Netherlands, Palestinian photographer and filmmaker Sakir Khader has regularly traveled to the Nablus and Jenin regions, which are under Israeli occupation. For several years, he has documented the living conditions of the youngest in this context of ongoing violence.
